exposure: Serum miR-192-5p expression levels (high vs. low)
outcome: Vaginal microecological environment status (postpartum vaginal leukocyte esterase, sialyl glycosidase, acetylglucosaminidase)
Postpartum class I muscle fiber strength
Postpartum class II muscle fiber strength
Severe postpartum complications (postoperative hemorrhage, abdominal incision infections, puerperal infections)
cohort: 145 subjects with scarred uteruses undergoing a caesarean section.
finding: MiR-192-5p expression levels were significantly associated with and predictive of postpartum class I/II muscle fiber strength, PFD score, vaginal microecological environment, and severe postpartum complications, suggesting its potential as a preoperative screening marker.
